name: Refinery electrification and heat pumps
principle: Fired heaters and boilers are replaced by electric heating, and low-temperature process heat is lifted with heat pumps. Evidence read here is for electric steam-cracker furnaces: BASF, SABIC and Linde started a demonstration at Ludwigshafen in April 2024 with two electrically heated furnaces, 6 MW of renewable power and about 4 t/h of feed, targeting 90% lower emissions.

process_steps.name: Electric heating of process fluid or furnace

performance.metric: emission reduction target of the electric furnace demonstration
performance.basis: target, not a measured result at the time of the article

limitations: Commercialisation depends on competitively priced renewable power (article)
